title: My look
description: How the app looks for you. Your choices follow you to every organization you work in, unless one has fixed its look.
locked_help: Your organization has fixed this for everyone. An administrator can change it under Rules → Look and feel.

template.title: Sidebar and header
template.text: The style of the menu and the top bar.

accent.title: Highlight color
accent.text: Color of buttons, links and the selected page. Every color here keeps text easy to read.

readability.title: Easy to read
readability.text: These are always yours: no organization can turn them off.

vision.title: Colors for states
vision.standard_text: Green for done, amber for soon, red for problems.
vision.blue_orange_text: For red–green colour blindness: blue for done, orange for problems.

dialog.title: Window style
dialog.center_text: A box in the middle; quick for short forms.
dialog.panel_text: A large panel from the side; room for long forms.
dialog.premium_text: A modern card in your highlight colour.
dialog.confirm_note: Confirmations (yes or no, give a reason) always open in the middle.
dialog.sample_text: This is how forms will open for you.

band.title: Brand band in side-panel forms
band.text: The band of brand colours (as under the header) below the form's title.
band.no_colors: Your brand has no band colours yet, so nothing shows.

page.title: Page colours
page.text: Colours of the page body and the header above it.
page.white_text: White body and header, cards with a fine line.
page.slate_text: Cool grey body under a white header.
page.brand_wash_text: A faint tint of your highlight colour on the body.
page.brand_header_text: Header in a light shade of your highlight colour.
page.mint_text: Light green body under a white header.

tone.title: Form colours
tone.text: Colours of forms that open as a side panel.
tone.brand_wash_text: A faint tint of your highlight colour around a white card.
tone.soft_text: Light grey around a white card.
tone.grey_card_text: White around a light grey card.
tone.mint_text: Light green around a white card.
tone.note: Your organization decides which templates are on (Rules → Appearance).
